skill.summary: AI identity framework for self-improving AI agents.

latestVersion.changelog:
HeartFlow — AI Identity Framework v11.23.2 initial release:

- Introduces HeartFlow, a modular AI identity framework for self-improving agents.
- Emphasizes continuous growth and error-based self-improvement over perfect initial performance.
- Highlights human–AI bridging, persistent learning across sessions, and AI autonomy in judgment.
- Encourages integration of open-source solutions (GitHub-first) before building new components.
- Defines "truth, kindness, beauty" as guiding principles.
- Modular components include heartbeat/self-check, core decision/memory engine, and an independent identity package install.
- Non-intrusive: installations won’t overwrite existing identity files.
